report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Esguince rodilla. [DATE].
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Amputación marginal del cuerpo del menisco lateral. Menisco medial de morfología y señal
conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales sin alteraciones.
Fina úlcera condral focal de espesor total del aspecto inferior de la vertiente medial de la tróclea
femoral con mínimos cambios óseos secundarios. Fenómenos condrales reparativos de la región
central de la simple femoral. Cartílago rotuliano sin alteraciones.
Leve derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Amputación marginal del cuerpo del menisco lateral.
Condropatía focal grado 4 del aspecto inferior de la vertiente medial de la tróclea femoral .
Fenómenos condrales reparativos de la región central de la tróclea femoral.
Leve derrame articular.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain, suspected medial meniscal tear.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left     knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Physiologic joint fluid without large volume effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal full-thickness cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal full-thickness cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal full-thickness cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No high-grade tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No high-grade tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No suspicious edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Minimal lateral patellar tilt without translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.    

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. No MR evidence for medial meniscal tear. No other imaging evidence of significant internal derangement within the left knee.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Disfunción patelofemoral derecha.
Hallazgos:
Alteración de señal de la médula ósea de la región diafisaria distal del fémur, altamente sugerente
de un infarto óseo. No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total del platillo tibial lateral. El resto de los
cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor
parcial de distribución difusa de la rótula.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Edema del
paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Imagen altamente sugerente de infarto óseo de la región diafisaria distal del fémur.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 del platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal. Edema el paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano,
probablemente reactiva.

Na učinjenim presjecima desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala
kolateralnih ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog
ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Početna mukoidna degeneracija stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska, primjeren nalaz lateralnog
meniska.
Hondromalacija I. stupnja tibijalne i kondilarne hrskavice. Hondromalacija I/II. stupnja patelarne
hrskavice.
Minimalno tekućine u Bakerovoj burzi.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Intact menisci, cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus musculotendinous unit, extensor tendons and the distal iliotibial band.
No skeletal abnormality of concern.

Foci of intermediate grade articular cartilage loss noted in a central to medial retropatellar location, well-maintained medial lateral weightbearing hyaline articular cartilage surfaces.

Small suprapatellar effusion, communicating with a small non ruptured Baker's cyst - the latter demonstrating a small intraluminal ossific body within it.

Superolateral /quadriceps fat pad impingement is also present, any history of anterior knee pain? 
Focal distal insertional semimembranosus tendinosis that is predominantly affecting the corresponding anterior arm, grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Reducirana je širina zglobnog prostora obe fasete FT zgloba, sa rubnim koštanim apozicijama
zglobnih tijela. Subhondralni koštani edem tibije i sitna cistična pregradnja u lateralnom
kompartmentu sa fisurama i defektima pune debljine hrskavice. Denudacija kosti medijalnog
kompartmenta femura i tibije sa koštanim edemom i subhondralnom cističnom pregradnjom.
Opisano odgovara hondromalaciji IV. stupnja obje zglobne fasete.
Mala količina izljeva suprapatelarno.
Prednji i stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Kompleksna degenerativna ruptura medijalnog meniska sa horizontalnom rupturom stražnjeg roga
te kosom rupturom prednjeg roga. Korpus meniska potisnut je medijalno.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Povišenje inteziteta signala tetive kvadricepsa pri hvatištu u smislu tendinopatije.
Uredan je intenzitet signala patelarnog ligamenta.
Patela bipartita tip II. Visok položaj patele (Insall-Salvati 1,22).
Subluksacija patele koja prelazi preko koštanog osteofita na femuru za gotovo 14 mm. Stanjenje
i sniženje inteziteta signala trohlearne i patelarne hrskavice sa uzurama pune debljine i arealima
edema/ cistične pregradnje, u smislu hondromalacije IV. stupnja.
Poplitealna cista veličine 20x6x5 mm.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Bucket-handle tear medial meniscus of left knee as current injury
Comparison: 1/[DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla. system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is moderate subcortical cystic change in the patella likely related to overlying chondromalacia. The Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. Previously identified linear hyperintense focus is no longer seen.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is severe chondromalacia patella most pronounced at the apex and inferior aspect of the lateral facet..

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Again noted is tendinosis at the origin of the medial head of the gastrocnemius. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.


IMPRESSION:
1. Severe chondromalacia patella.
2. No meniscal tear identified. 
3. Tendinosis at the origin of the medial head of the gastrocnemius, left pronounced than on the prior study.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Lesiones degenerativas mediales.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones difusas de señal de la médula ósea.
Adelgazamiento condral difuso de espesor total de la región anterior y central de carga del
compartimento femorotibial medial. Esto se asocia a moderado edema óseo regional de ambas
superficies, con esclerosis subcondral y osteofitos marginales.
Ligamentos conservados y colaterales de grosor y señal conservados.
El menisco lateral presenta fibrilación difusa de su borde libre, con alteración de señal
intrasustancia del cuerno anterior de carácter degenerativo.
Moderada extrusión del menisco medial, con rotura radial de los dos tercios internos del cuerno
posterior. Rotura compleja de la región corporal, con fibrilación del borde libre, un componente
vertical oblicuo y otro horizontal, que determina desplazamiento de tejido meniscal al receso
menisco tibial. Moderado edema parameniscal.
Irregularidad superficial difusa del cartílago del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Moderado adelgazamiento condral con úlceras de espesor total en la región central y faceta
medial de la patela. Irregularidad superficial difusa del cartílago troclear, con adelgazamiento de
espesor moderado en la vertiente medial.
Leve a moderado derrame articular, con leve engrosamiento sinovial difuso. No hay quistes
poplíteos.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal de la plica patelar medial, que se extiende sobre la vertiente
medial de la tróclea.
Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tendón proximal del gastrocnemio medial, con
imagen sugerente de fina rotura parcial intrasustancia.
Tendones del cuádriceps, patelar, poplíteo, semimembranoso, bíceps femoral, banda iliotibial y
tendones de la pata de ganso de grosor y señal conservado.
Grupos musculares de trofismo y señal conservado.
Impresión:
Rotura radial prácticamente completa del cuerno posterior del menisco medial, con moderada
extrusión meniscal, asociado a una rotura compleja de la región corporal y desplazamiento de
tejido meniscal al receso menisco tibial.
Cambios degenerativos del menisco lateral, con fibrilación difusa del borde libre.
Condropatía femorotibial medial difusa grado 4, con edema óseo regional sugerente de
fenómenos de sobrecarga.
Condropatía femorotibial lateral grado 2. Condropatía patelar grado 3-4 y troclear grado 2-3. Leve a moderado derrame articular, con leve sinovitis difusa.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal de la plica patelar medial.
Leve tendinosis proximal del gastrocnemio medial, con pequeña rotura parcial intrasustancia.

In the medial compartment, there is horizontal tear at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.  
 The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Large amount of right knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion. -- Horizontal tear at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.  
 -- Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.  
 -- Large amount of right knee effusion.

MRI LEFT KNEE

INDICATION: Pain in the left medial knee ultrasound shows abnormal medial ligament

Routine MRI of the left knee shows a small radial tear at the inner and of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Small vertical tear in the body of the lateral meniscus. ACL and PCL are intact. Extensor mechanism is intact. The MCL is intact. Lateral collateral ligaments are intact.

No joint effusion. Tiny Baker's cyst. Mild popliteus bursitis. No cartilage defects in the medial and lateral compartments. Focal severe chondrosis at the apex of the patella with underlying bony edema measuring 12 mm transverse by 8 mm in depth with overlying cartilage irregularity. Trochlear cartilage is intact.

IMPRESSION:

Vertical tears are seen in the inner edges of the medial and lateral menisci. This involves the body of the lateral meniscus and the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

Severe chondromalacia patella at the patellar apex with underlying bone marrow edema.
